other_conditions: Applicant must be a native of Rajasthan
Applicant must own at least 0.3 hectares of cultivable land at a single location in his/her name (minimum 0.5 hectares if joint account holder)
Subsidy is payable only for farm ponds with a minimum capacity of 400 cubic metres
benefits_summary: Provides a subsidy of up to 70% (maximum ₹73,500) for SC/ST farmers and up to 60% (maximum ₹63,000) for other farmers on raw farm ponds, with higher percentages for plastic‑lined ponds.
